```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(brms)
library(kableExtra)
library(xtable)
library(tidybayes)
```

```{r}
model_w_controls <- readRDS(here("Output", "Models", "model3.rds"))
table_model_w_controls <- summary(model_w_controls)
```

#### Fixed effects
```{r}
table_model_w_controls_fx <- as.data.frame(table_model_w_controls$fixed)
table_model_w_controls_fx <- tibble::rownames_to_column(table_model_w_controls_fx, "name")

table_model_w_controls_fx <- table_model_w_controls_fx %>% 
  mutate(name = case_match(
    name,
    "Intercept[1]" ~ "Threshold of attitude extremity: 1-2",
    "Intercept[2]" ~ "Threshold of attitude extremity: 2-3",
    "min_maj_scale_1" ~ "Majority-Minority Scale", 
    "min_maj_scale_sq" ~ "Majority-Minority Scale^2",
    "fr1" ~ "Framing: Yes",
    "min_maj_scale_1:fr1" ~ "Majority-Minority Scale*Framing: Yes",
    "fr1:min_maj_scale_sq" ~ "Majority-Minority Scale^2*Framing: Yes"
  ))

colnames(table_model_w_controls_fx) <- c("name", "Estimate", "Est.Error", "lCI",  "uCI", "Rhat", "Bulk_ESS", "Tail_ESS")

table_model_w_controls_fx <- table_model_w_controls_fx %>% 
  reframe(name = name,  
            B = round(Estimate,2),
            SE = round(Est.Error, 2),
            CIl_CIh = sprintf("[%.2f; %.2f]", lCI, uCI),
            Rhat = format(round(Rhat, digits=2), nsmall = 2) ,
            Bulk_ESS = round(Bulk_ESS),
            Tail_ESS = round(Tail_ESS))
```
```{r}
latex_code_table1 <- xtable(table_model_w_controls_fx)
latex_code_table1 <- capture.output(print(latex_code_table1, booktabs = TRUE))
writeLines(latex_code_table1, here("Output", "Tables", "table_for_overleaf.tex"))
```
#### Random effects
```{r}
table_model_w_controls_rf <- as.data.frame(table_model_w_controls$random)

table_model_w_controls_rf_Q <- table_model_w_controls_rf %>% 
  select(., starts_with("anti_t_laws_q")) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., "name")

colnames(table_model_w_controls_rf_Q) <- c("name", "Estimate", "Est.Error", "lCI",  "uCI", "Rhat", "Bulk_ESS", "Tail_ESS")
  
table_model_w_controls_rf_state <- table_model_w_controls_rf %>%
  select(., starts_with("state")) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., "name")

colnames(table_model_w_controls_rf_state) <- c("name", "Estimate", "Est.Error", "lCI",  "uCI", "Rhat", "Bulk_ESS", "Tail_ESS")


table_model_w_controls_rf_Q <- table_model_w_controls_rf_Q %>% 
  reframe(name = name,  
            B = round(Estimate,2),
            SE = round(Est.Error, 2),
            CIl_CIh = sprintf("[%.2f; %.2f]", lCI, uCI),
            Rhat = format(round(Rhat, digits=2), nsmall = 2) ,
            Bulk_ESS = round(Bulk_ESS),
            Tail_ESS = round(Tail_ESS))

table_model_w_controls_rf_state <- table_model_w_controls_rf_state %>% 
  filter(name == "sd(Intercept)") %>% 
  reframe(name = name,  
            B = round(Estimate,2),
            SE = round(Est.Error, 2),
            CIl_CIh = sprintf("[%.2f; %.2f]", lCI, uCI),
            Rhat = format(round(Rhat, digits=2), nsmall = 2) ,
            Bulk_ESS = round(Bulk_ESS),
            Tail_ESS = round(Tail_ESS))
```

```{r}
# 1. Build the design matrix you want predictions for ------------------------
#   ↳ adjust the ±2 to whatever "strong" means on your min_maj_scale_1
scenarios <- expand_grid(
  min_maj_scale_1 = c(1, 1.5, 2),        # strong-minority, middle, strong-majority
  fr            = c(0, 1)              # 0 = control, 1 = framing
) %>% 
   mutate(
    min_maj_scale_sq = min_maj_scale_1 ^ 2    # (min_maj_scale + 1)^2
  ) %>%
  arrange(min_maj_scale_1, fr)         # keeps rows in a tidy order

# 2. Posterior expected probabilities for every category ---------------------
#    posterior_epred(): draws × observations × categories
post_epred <- posterior_epred(
  model_w_controls,
  newdata     = scenarios,
  re_formula  = NA            # population-level predictions only
)

# choose which category is your "extreme" one -------------------------------
# here I assume the *highest* category is extreme; change if needed
ext_cat <- dim(post_epred)[3]           # last category
ext_prob <- post_epred[ , , ext_cat ]   # draws × observations

# summarise over posterior draws --------------------------------------------
scenarios$prob_extreme <- colMeans(ext_prob)    # posterior mean
scenarios$sd_extreme   <- apply(ext_prob, 2, sd)

# 3. %-change: framing vs control inside each minority-majority group --------
pct_change <- scenarios %>%                     # <— the tibble that already has
  select(min_maj_scale_1, fr, prob_extreme) %>%#     min_maj_scale_*, fr1, prob_extreme
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = fr,
    values_from = prob_extreme,
    names_prefix = "frame_"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    pct_change = (frame_1 - frame_0) / frame_0 * 100
  )

pct_change

# (Optional) round and merge into your effect table -------------------------
pct_change_fmt <- pct_change %>% 
  transmute(
    name       = case_when(
      min_maj_scale_1 == 1 ~ "Strong majority : %Δ extreme (frame vs ctrl)",
      min_maj_scale_1 == 1.5 ~ "Middle: %Δ extreme (frame vs ctrl)",
      min_maj_scale_1 == 2  ~ "Strong minority: %Δ extreme (frame vs ctrl)"
    ),
    B          = round(pct_change, 1)
  )
```
